exam.gateIntro: A mock exam in the same format as the real one. Take it in a single sitting, without looking anything up: the point is to measure where you are, and an inflated score can't tell you whether you're ready.
exam.gateFactFlagging: You can leave questions blank, flag them, and come back
exam.gateFactAutoSubmit: It submits itself when the clock runs out
exam.gateNotSaved: This attempt won't be saved. If you close the tab, it's gone.
exam.gateNotSavedSignIn: Sign in before you start if you want to keep the result.
exam.startFailed: We couldn't open the attempt. Try again in a moment.
exam.questionsOnlyInSpanish: The questions in this exam are still only available in Spanish. The interface is in your language.
exam.confirmUnanswered: You have {count} unanswered. There's no penalty for a wrong answer, so it's worth marking something on every question before you submit.
exam.autoSubmittedNotice: This was submitted automatically because the time ran out.
exam.passMarkNote: You need {score} out of {max} to pass.
exam.unansweredNote: You left {count} blank, and they count as wrong. The real exam has no penalty for a wrong answer: never leave one empty.
exam.approximationNote: This score is an approximation. The real exam includes 15 questions that don't count and uses an equating model AWS doesn't publish, so treat the number as a signal that you're close, not as an exact prediction.
exam.domainNote: Use this to spot which domain to go back to. With few questions per domain, one right or wrong answer moves the percentage a lot, so read it as a signal rather than a grade.
exam.retakeHint: Study your weakest domain first: taking it again without studying measures exactly what you just measured.

exam.confirmBody: Once you submit you can't answer any more, and you'll see your score plus a review of all {total} questions.
exam.confirmFlagged: You still have {count} flagged for review.
exam.reviewIntro: Here's every question with the correct answer and why each option is or isn't right.
exam.saveFailedNotice: We're not able to save your answers right now. You can keep going, but don't close the tab.

exams.title: Exams
exams.intro: Exams that don't belong to any course, grouped by certification or topic. Take one against the clock to measure where you are, or without a timer to learn from every answer as you go.
exams.groupEmpty: This group has no tests yet.
exams.ungroupedIntro: These tests aren't in any group yet.
exams.cardPendingReview: {count, plural, one {# to review} other {# to review}}
exams.cardExams: {count, plural, =0 {No tests yet} one {# test} other {# tests}}
exams.pendingAll: {count, plural, one {You have # question waiting} other {You have # questions waiting}}.
exams.pendingNone: Nothing to review yet. Take an exam and whatever you miss shows up here.
exams.startTitle: How do you want to take it
exams.startIntro: Both modes use the same questions. What changes is when you see the answers.
exams.modeExamDescription: Timed, with no hints. Nothing is revealed until you submit: only then do you see your score, what you missed, and why. It's the only way to know how you'd really do.
exams.modeStudyDescription: No timer. The moment you pick an option it reveals the right answer, why it's right, and why each other one isn't. For learning, not for measuring.
exams.durationHint: Between {min} and {max} minutes. Suggested for this exam: {suggested}.
exams.durationInvalid: Pick a duration between {min} and {max} minutes.
exams.resumeExamRemaining: You have an exam in progress, with {time} left.
exams.resumeStudyProgress: You have a review in progress: {answered} of {total} answered.
exams.notSaved: This won't be saved. If you close the tab, it's gone.
exams.notSavedSignIn: Sign in before you start if you want to keep the result.
exams.startFailed: We couldn't open the exam. Try again in a moment.
exams.studyRevealHint: Pick an option to see the answer and the explanations.
exams.unansweredNote: You left {count, plural, one {# blank, and it counts} other {# blank, and they count}} as wrong. There's no penalty for a wrong answer: never leave one empty.
exams.autoSubmittedNotice: This was submitted automatically because the time ran out.
exams.confirmUnanswered: You have {count} unanswered. There's no penalty for a wrong answer, so it's worth marking something on every question before you submit.
exams.topicNote: The share each topic takes up is ours, chosen when the exam was written — not an official blueprint. With few questions per topic, one right answer moves the percentage a lot: read it as a hint about where to go next, not as a grade.
exams.reviewAttempt: Review this attempt question by question
exams.goToReview: See what I need to review
exams.reviewIntro: What you missed and what you flagged in this exam, with the right answer and why each option is or isn't correct.
exams.reviewEmpty: Nothing to review in this exam. Take it and whatever you miss shows up here.
exams.reviewWrongIntro: You missed these and haven't got them right since. They leave this list once you get them right in study mode.
exams.reviewFlaggedIntro: You flagged these yourself. They stay until you remove the flag.
exams.reviewDroppedByVersion: {count, plural, one {There is # question from an older attempt that is no longer in this exam and can't be shown} other {There are # questions from older attempts that are no longer in this exam and can't be shown}}.
exams.groupExercisesIntro: The textbook's exercises, to solve in your notebook and compare with the step-by-step solution. They are not graded.
exams.exercisesIntro: Solve each exercise in your notebook. When you are done, press “Solve” and compare your work with the step-by-step solution.

practice.title: Coding practice
practice.intro: Challenges with a statement, an editor and automatic grading, to prepare for live technical interviews. Each one has hidden cases with the classic interview traps.
practice.hintsIntro: Hints go from the most general to the most specific. Open only the ones you need.
practice.solutionLocked: The solution unlocks once you submit an answer. Trying first is what makes the explanation stick.
practice.giveUp: Give up and show the solution
practice.giveUpConfirm: Sure? Seeing the solution now takes value away from the challenge.
practice.resetConfirm: Reset? Your code will be lost
practice.shortcutHint: Ctrl + Enter runs (only the selection, if any)
practice.resultsEmpty: “Run” checks your code against the sample and shows the output. “Submit” also runs the hidden cases. If you select part of the code, “Run” executes only that, ungraded: use it to explore the data.
practice.mismatchColumnCount: The number of columns doesn't match the expected one.
practice.mismatchColumnNames: Column names don't match: check your aliases and their order.
practice.mismatchRowCount: The number of rows doesn't match the expected one.
practice.mismatchRowValues: The rows don't match the expected ones.
practice.mismatchRowAt: The first difference is at row {row}.
practice.timeout: The run took longer than {seconds} seconds and was stopped. Is there a query that never ends?
practice.fatal: Problem with the challenge, not your code: {message}
practice.unsupportedLanguage: This language has no execution engine in the app yet: write your solution, check it against the sample tests and then review the solution. Interview mode is not available either.
practice.errorMultipleStatements: Your code has more than one statement. To grade it, keep only your answer query (comment the others out with --), or select one statement to run it on its own.
practice.exploreNotGraded: Exploration only: this is not graded.
practice.exploreNoRows: {count, plural, =0 {The selection returned no rows.} one {The statement ran without returning rows.} other {The # statements ran without returning rows.}}
practice.mismatchRowOrder: The rows are right, but in a different order. Check your ORDER BY: without it, Postgres guarantees no order.
practice.cardAttempted: {count, plural, one {# unsolved attempt} other {# unsolved attempts}}
practice.solvedCount: {count, plural, =0 {Not solved yet} one {Solved once} other {Solved # times}}
practice.saveFailed: This submission couldn't be saved to your history. The result above is still valid.
practice.historyEmpty: You haven't submitted this challenge yet. Every “Submit” is saved here.
practice.interviewStartIntro: You'll solve this challenge under the conditions of a live technical interview.
practice.ruleTimer: You have {minutes} minutes. The clock keeps running even if you reload or close the tab.
practice.ruleNoHints: No hints or solution until you submit.
practice.ruleRun: You can run against the sample and explore the data as many times as you like.
practice.ruleOneSubmit: You submit once. If time runs out, whatever you have written is submitted.
practice.ruleThinkAloud: Tip: explain what you're doing out loud, as you would in front of the interviewer.
practice.submitFinalConfirm: Submit now? It is graded against every case and you won't be able to submit again.
practice.finalPassed: Interview passed: your answer passed every case.
practice.finalFailed: Your answer didn't pass every case.
practice.finalAuto: It was submitted automatically when time ran out.
practice.finalUnlocked: Hints and the solution are now available.
practice.mockCtaText: Several challenges on a single clock, picked by the platform among the ones you've solved the least.
practice.mockIntro: Pick a format. The platform picks the challenges (the least solved of each level) and doesn't tell you which until you start, like a real interview.
practice.mockUnavailable: There aren't enough challenges at one of these levels for this format.
practice.mockHowPicked: Total time is the sum of each challenge's suggested minutes. Every visit to this page draws different challenges among the tied ones.
practice.mockStartIntro: {count, plural, one {# challenge} other {# challenges}} in {minutes} minutes.
practice.mockRuleTimer: A single {minutes}-minute clock for all challenges. It keeps running if you reload.
practice.mockRuleSwitch: You can switch between challenges whenever you want; split your time as in the interview.
practice.mockRuleEnd: When time runs out, or if you finish early, whatever you have in each challenge is submitted.
practice.mockEndConfirm: Whatever you have in the pending challenges will be submitted.
practice.mockSummaryHint: Hints and the solution of each challenge are now unlocked, below and in practice mode.
practice.mockCustomText: Build your own mock interview: choose the levels, the languages, which challenges to prioritize and how many. The platform still picks which ones, without telling you until you start.
practice.mockCustomAvailable: {count, plural, =0 {No challenge matches these filters.} one {# challenge available with these filters.} other {# challenges available with these filters.}}
practice.mockCustomFewer: You asked for more than there are: the mock interview will have {available}.
practice.mockCustomNoStats: Without signing in there is no history, so challenges are picked at random.
practice.mockCustomSpread: Challenges are split evenly across the chosen levels and go from easiest to hardest. The total time is shown when you start.
practice.mockCustomEmpty: No challenge matched that configuration. Try other filters.
